evidence.observation: Settled at the 750.0 setpoint after a small, typical overshoot to 760.5 at the start of growth
44.5% hold power is consistent with the ramp trend and the thermocouple reading
Steady at ~3.0 Torr with 100 sccm Ar
Stays low (~5-7 ppm) after the purge, so no sign of a leak
